chunks: Musa ibn al-Qasim narrated from Safwan, from Mu'awiya ibn 'Ammar, from Abu 'Abdillah (peace be upon him) who said:
Ali (peace be upon him) used to say: 'For every month, an Umrah.'
ai.seo_question: What did Imam Ali say about performing Umrah every month?
ai.summary: In this narration from *Tahdhib al-Ahkam*, Imam Ali (peace be upon him) recommends performing an Umrah every month, emphasizing the spiritual purification and continuous devotion associated with the minor pilgrimage. This practice is often interpreted by Shia scholars as a means to expiate minor sins and maintain a state of ritual purity, complementing the annual Hajj. The emphasis on monthly Umrah reflects the high status of Mecca as a sanctuary of peace and the importance of regular spiritual retreats in Shia piety.
